methods.what: Partial differential equation for U in coordinates log rho and psi on an annular region
Conformal map relation via logarithm and differential
Expression of mass (charge) element through normal derivative of U
Double Fourier-type series expansion of boundary values
Fourier coefficients as Euler integral and hypergeometric function with Gamma (Pi) factors
